categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of vacuum insulation panels (VIP) and insulation boxes. It also develops downstream applications of vacuum insulation technology, including vacuum glass and new building insulation materials. The main products serve the household appliance sector (refrigerators, freezers) and cold chain logistics (medical and food insulation boxes).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary technologies in high-performance, low-cost core material formulations, high-barrier membrane preparation, adsorbent formulation, vacuum packaging, and thermal conductivity testing. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including vacuum sealing, multi-disciplinary integration of vacuum science, materials science, and heat transfer, and has developed automated production equipment for post-processing steps. The company also innovates in new product structures such as four-edge sealed VIP and metal VIP for expanded applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international household appliance manufacturers such as Samsung, LG, Bosch, Haier, Midea, and Hisense. The products are mainly used in high-energy-efficiency refrigerators and freezers, as well as medical and food cold chain logistics. The company also targets emerging markets like building insulation, high-temperature electrical appliances, and LNG pipeline insulation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Fujian and Anhui provinces. Its products are sold domestically and exported internationally, covering major markets in Europe, North America, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia. Overseas sales accounted for approximately 55% of total revenue in 2023.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, producing core vacuum insulation materials and components for appliance manufacturers and cold chain logistics providers. It integrates upstream production of core materials like ultra-fine glass fiber to ensure supply stability, thus controlling key parts of the production chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity, enhancing automation, and deepening R&D in new VIP structures and materials such as four-edge sealed VIP, metal VIP, lightweight VIP, and vacuum glass. The company emphasizes innovation in core materials, barrier membranes, adsorbents, and testing technologies. It also pursues industry standardization and collaborates with universities and research institutes to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through customized sales of vacuum insulation panels and insulation boxes to downstream appliance manufacturers and cold chain logistics companies. The company uses direct sales and intermediary sales channels, with pricing based on product specifications, performance, and market conditions negotiated per contract.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the global leading manufacturers of vacuum insulation panels, competing with firms like Sichuan Maikelong Vacuum New Materials, Chuzhou Yinxing New Materials, and Germany's va-Q-tec. It holds a leading market position in China and internationally, supported by advanced technology, scale, and strong customer relationships. The industry is emerging with increasing competition from new entrants and alternative insulation materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 840 million, a 31.69% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 106 million, up 66.14%. Total assets reached RMB 1.88 billion, growing 61.48%. The company has steadily increased R&D investment and expanded production capacity, with a strong growth trajectory supported by rising demand for energy-efficient insulation materials.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-performance vacuum insulation panels with superior thermal insulation, thin thickness, light weight, and environmental friendliness. Its vertically integrated production chain ensures stable quality and supply. Continuous innovation in materials and manufacturing processes enables customized solutions that improve energy efficiency in appliances and cold chain logistics, supporting global energy-saving and carbon reduction goals.
